ruling_basis: Manual static inspection with pinned Rabbitizer and comparison to the private M0 RAM snapshot; not a new runtime trace.

sections.name: initial_image
sections.provenance: IPL3 ROM 0x4c0..0x514 reads header entry, programs PI source ROM 0x1000, destination entry & 0x1fffffff and transfer length 0x100000. This is a loaded image, not an all-code section.

human_rulings.provenance: Rabbitizer IPL3 listing at ROM 0x4c0..0x514; relocated boot code executes from RAM. Static register/dataflow inspection.
Entry loop 0x80025c60..0x80025c74; two word stores per iteration and pointer increment in branch delay slot. Overwrites part of initial_image and extends beyond it.
Entry register-indirect jump has a constant target; stack pointer completed in its delay slot.

Bound check for seven entries, index shift by two, base formation and pointer load at 0x800accdc. All seven destinations lie within 0x800acb94..0x800adbc0. Automatic pointer run merges neighboring tables.
Rabbitizer confirms jalr through t9 loaded from a structure at offset 0x30. Target set and callback semantics remain open.
M0 seed is an interior instruction of the candidate beginning at 0x80070118; preceding code falls through, no matching call-target evidence. Rejected as an independent function start.
First snapshot divergence is mutable scheduler state, not the initial DMA endpoint. IPL3 establishes a larger 1 MiB initial transfer.
